The Garnish Collective is a luxury events and catering company based in Yorkshire, delivering unforgettable experiences across the UK and beyond. Led by MasterChef finalist Chris Hale, our team has had the privilege of catering for royalty, world-class athletes, and A-list celebrities around the world. A testament to the standard upheld at every event.
What Do you Need?
We’ll help you choose the perfect services, styling, and extras to bring your vision to life.
Weddings
VIEW
Create your dream day with tailored menus, beautiful styling, and memorable service. 
Enjoy stunning settings, seamless coordination, and a stress-free experience from start to finish.
Corporate
VIEW
Host productive, memorable business events with flexible catering packages, professional bar hire, and custom branding. Choose from event styling, venue access, and complete planning support.
Celebrations &
Special Events
VIEW
Make birthdays, parties, and milestones unforgettable with creative food choices, entertaining bar setups, and decor that pops. Pick your perfect package and let us bring the style, service, and fun.
With an innovative approach to culinary artistry and event management, The Garnish Collective provides bespoke catering solutions to events from corporate days to wedding banquets.
Crafted with Vision
From MasterChef to
Creative Mastermind
We are proud to be led by the incredible Chris Hale, founder and head chef of The Garnish Collective.
As a former MasterChef UK quarter-finalist, Chris has built a reputation for pushing culinary boundaries with creativity, precision, and flair. His career has taken him across the globe, where he has cooked for royalty, world-class athletes, and A-list celebrities.
Experiences that have shaped his vision for delivering extraordinary dining at every level.
